svg.aria-label: Stacked bars of the monthly tension added by wars, infamy, rivalries, bitter relations, contested spheres and an active crisis in an example world, against the decay line and the tension level with its spawn floor of 35. A second panel shows the monthly crisis spawn chance rising from 5 percent at tension 35 to 50 percent at 100.
